summary: End-to-end UI testing of the new 'Mirror Production Database' admin feature on /admin. All flows pass: login, Mirror DB tab visibility, mirror panel rendering, confirm/cancel UX, mirror execution against live production, success result block with non-zero counts, no error block, and public homepage sanity check.
tests_executed: Login at /admin with password 'xaluca' via data-testid admin-login-password + admin-login-submit — success.
Verified left-rail tab 'Mirror DB' (data-testid admin-tab-mirror) is present and clickable.

Verified mirror-panel renders with title 'Mirror Production Database', source row 'https://xalucatravel.com', destination row, destructive warning, and primary 'Mirror Production Database' button (mirror-start-btn).

Click mirror-start-btn → mirror-confirm-row appears with mirror-confirm-btn (label 'Sí, sobrescribir') and mirror-cancel-btn. Cancel returns to initial start button state (confirm-row removed, start-btn re-shown).

Click mirror-start-btn → mirror-confirm-btn → success result mirror-result rendered within ~10s. Counts: Textos y traducciones=98, Imágenes (Edit Image)=1032, Galerías por día=457, Biblioteca de imágenes=4035, Precios=Sí. mirror-error block NOT shown.
Public home (https://morocco-trips-2.preview.emergentagent.com/) loads correctly post-mirror: title 'Xaluca Tours · Viajes a medida por Marruecos', 261 elements rendered.
No JS console errors observed during the admin flow (only React DevTools info log).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.jsx is 1100+ lines with the MirrorPanel inlined — consider extracting MirrorPanel into its own component file under /app/frontend/src/components/admin/ for maintainability (file-size guideline >700 lines).
Mirror result counts are hardcoded in the JSX; if backend ever returns additional collections, the panel won't reflect them. Consider rendering the full mirrored object dynamically.
seed_data_creation: None — mirror is idempotent and re-pulls live production into preview DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Mirror DB feature is fully functional in the UI. Backend POST /api/admin/mirror-production was already verified separately by main agent. Re-running the mirror is safe (idempotent overwrite). Counts observed match production: 98 texts / 1032 image_slots / 457 day_galleries / 4035 files / pricing=true.
